title: nephrodium molle var. aureum
intro: Nephrodium molle var. aureum, commonly known as the golden maidenhair fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which may help alleviate various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium molle var. aureum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it useful in treating conditions like fever, kidney stones, and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
